business_summary: Guangdong Syntrust GK Testing and Certification Tech Service Center Co., Ltd. provides construction engineering testing and inspection services in the People's Republic of China. The company offers testing services for foundations, building structures, construction materials, highway and water transport engineering, infrastructure and public roads, products and materials, environment, and housing appraisal products. It also provides inspection services for slopes, foundation fit monitoring, and water conservancy projects; and food and agricultural testing services. In addition, the company offers motor vehicle and hydraulic engineering testing services, fire protection technical services, and safety assessment services. It serves private and public sector entities, such as property developers and construction companies, state-owned investment companies, government institutions, and government administrative bureaus. The company was formerly known as Xinyi Xince Testing and Certification Technology Service Center Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Guangdong Syntrust GK Testing and Certification Tech Service Center Co., Ltd. in October 2023. Guangdong Syntrust GK Testing and Certification Tech Service Center Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Xinyi, China.
